simple.summary: חֵלֶד (chêled) means Cheled , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 30.

definitions.full: H2466. Cheled חֵ֫לֶד proper name, masculine (Sabean proper name חֿלד DHM Epigr. Denkm. 35 ) one of David's heroes, son of בַּעֲנָה 1Chr 11:30 A ᵐ5 L Αλαδ (= חֶלְדַּי 27:15 = חֵלֶב 2Sam 23:29 ).
